As physical AI systems advance, the demand for richly labeled datasets is accelerating beyond what we can manually capture in the real world. World foundation models (WFMs), which are generative AI models trained to simulate, predict, and reason about future world states based on the dynamics of real-world environments, can help overcome this data challenge.
